recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: august fog settling over the bay before noon
overcast summer holding san francisco at fifteen degrees
sunset creeping past eight on a long august evening
quiet week at the keyboard, agents waiting in the wings
shipping dreams timed to the first light

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Dodge rolling fog banks on a rooftop runway while catching golden sunrise tokens before they dissolve in the mist.
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: swipe left/right to slip between three rooftop lanes
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: Each sunrise token you grab adds a streak multiplier; missing one feels like letting dawn slip away.
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: Fog walls thicken and sweep faster; tokens spawn in tighter windows as the round nears sixty seconds.
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: soft watercolor fog layers over muted summer dawn palette

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Tap in rhythm with parallel agent pulses — each beat spawns a tiny worker that either ships or stalls depending on your timing.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: tap on beat; hold on sustained notes to queue a batch deploy
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: Nailing a four-beat chain launches all agents at once for a satisfying synchronized ship.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: Tempo climbs and off-beat taps spawn glitchy duplicates that clog the pipeline until you clear them with a perfect streak.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: neon wireframe agents marching on a dark terminal grid

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Draw one continuous deployment path from phone to cloud — your finger routes agents through shortcuts, actions, and CLI gates before sunrise deadline.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: drag to sketch a route; release to launch all queued agents along it
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: Watching a dozen tiny agents follow your drawn arc and converge at a glowing ship button in under a minute.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: New obstacle nodes appear mid-round — firewall loops, rate-limit zigzags — forcing path redraws under a shrinking countdown.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: paper cutout icons on a corkboard blueprint

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Sort incoming commit cards into ship-now, iterate, or archive piles before the overcast sky clears and the deploy window closes.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: flick cards left, right, or up into three bins
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: Clearing a full stack with zero mis-sorts triggers a crisp 'shipped' chime and a sunrise reveal.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: Cards arrive faster with ambiguous labels; occasional wildcard cards demand a quick tap-hold to inspect before sorting.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: minimal flat UI with warm amber accents against cool gray fog backdrop
